task.ques: Find daytime only parking nearest to Madison Square Garden. Summarize what people are saying about it.

claude.final_answer:
FINAL: For a daytime-only stay, choose New Garden Garage / Park N’ Lock, 218–230 W 31st St, across from Madison Square Garden. Parkopedia’s Distance sort lists it first, a 3-minute walk away.

I treated “daytime only” as a same-day visit and checked October 28, 2026, 9 a.m.–5 p.m. The displayed estimate is $43.25 for eight hours. The garage itself operates 24 hours.

The names refer to the same facility: Gigoso explicitly identifies New Garden Garage as Park N Lock. Parkopedia lists New Garden Garage at 218–230 W 31st St with phone 212-736-8233; Google Maps lists Park N’ Lock at 228 W 31st St with that same phone number.

Google Maps rates Park N’ Lock 4.4/5 from 47 reviews. People praise the convenient location, self-parking while keeping their keys, feeling safe, and helpful staff. Service experiences vary: a repeat MSG visitor’s review from a month ago described trouble-free parking and helpful employees, while a reviewer from three months ago complained about an unpleasant, controlling employee.

Sources checked October 27, 2026:
- Daytime window, Distance ranking, price and walk: https://en.parkopedia.com/parking/building/madison-square-garden-center-new-york-ny/?arriving=202610280900&leaving=202610281700
- New Garden Garage address, phone and hours: https://en.parkopedia.com/parking/garage/new_garden_garage/10001/new_york_city/?arriving=202610280900&leaving=202610281700
- Explicit identification as Park N Lock: https://gigoso.com/guides/parking/madison-square-garden
- Park N’ Lock address, matching phone, rating and reviews: https://www.google.com/maps/place/Park+N'+Lock/@40.7495804,-73.9958947,17z/data=!3m2!4b1!5s0x89c259ae350b9551:0x547569f890d03158!4m6!3m5!1s0x89c259ae362009b7:0xce521427e4bc3c9a!8m2!3d40.7495764!4d-73.9933198!16s%2Fg%2F11f656kdb6?hl=en

Evidence image: final.png shows the daytime window, Distance sort, New Garden Garage, $43.25 for eight hours and the 3-minute walk together.
